name: mask the message with a fresh shared secret derived from an ephemeral exponent
mechanism: the sender picks a fresh secret exponent, publishes the generator raised to it, forms the shared value from the recipient's public power, and multiplies the message by that value; the recipient recomputes the shared value from the published ephemeral and divides it out

sources.ref: List of algorithms (revid 1373672109), entry 'ElGamal' in section Computer science / Cryptography:

requires: a fresh random exponent per message
fails_when: reusing the ephemeral leaks the ratio of two messages; ciphertext is twice the message size
